exceptions.item-list: A card framing a list of item rows edge to edge: no padding, since each row carries its own padding and the hairline between rows. brand's card pads its content.
exceptions.priority-pill: An item's priority on brand's scale (data-priority) in the mono face, as a code the eye scans down the list. brand's pill sets Inter.
exceptions.image-tile: A review folder's image as a link: a card at half the padding, so the thumbnail fills the tile in a grid of two or three. brand's card pads its content by the card padding.
